gates.G1: paired (challenger - base) margin MSE AND total MSE, all games, date-block bootstrap 95% upper bound < 0 on BOTH 2024 and 2025
gates.G2: same diffs on 2027 live: point estimate <= 0 (not worse)
gates.G3: moneyline logloss diff upper bound <= 0 on 2024 and 2025
gates.promotion: only if G1-G3 pass; no parameter search beyond these two declared points; market is never an input

amendment_GC3.value_0.6: the GC1 declared point (no new search)

gates.T1: total MSE diff ub < 0 on BOTH 2024 and 2025
gates.T2: margin MSE diff ub <= +0.5 on 2024 and 2025 (strength protected)
gates.T3: 2027 live total diff point <= 0 and margin diff point <= +1.0
gates.T4: ML logloss diff ub <= 0.001 on 2024 and 2025
gates.T5: protected |market spread| >= 12 band: margin MSE diff point <= +0.5 on 2024 and 2025
